title: Wiz regulates clustered protocadherin genes by restricting CTCF/cohesin loop extrusion in a genomic-distance biased manner.
authors: Li, Tianjie; Li, Jingwei; Wang, Leyang; Huang, Haiyan; Wu, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文开发深度学习工具COP预测C2H2-ZFP在基因组上的结合，并研究Wiz通过限制CTCF/cohesin环挤压调控原钙粘蛋白基因表达，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非典型TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Zinc finger proteins (ZFPs or ZNFs) constitute the largest family of transcription factors in mammals; however, their regulatory mechanism remains largely elusive. Here we propose COP (C2H2-ZFP occupancy predictor), a deep learning-based heuristic screening tool that integrates DNA sequence with protein primary and secondary features to assess ZFP genomic enrichments. Applying COP to the mouse clustered protocadherin (cPcdh) gene locus, we identified dozens of C2H2-ZFPs potentially involved in CTCF-mediated gene regulation with Wiz (widely interspaced zinc finger-containing protein) having the highest number of 12 ZFs. We confirmed Wiz enrichments at all of the CTCF-binding site (CBS) elements across the three Pcdh clusters by Myc-tagging the endogenous Wiz gene. Genetic experiments revealed significant increases of expression levels of the cPcdh genes upon Wiz deletion in both neuronal cells in vitro and in mouse brain in vivo. Finally, integrated ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, and 4C-seq analyses demonstrated that Wiz regulates CTCF/cohesin occupancy and long-range enhancer-promoter contacts in a genomic-distance biased manner. Together, these findings reveal a key role for Wiz in coupling cohesin occupancy to long-range cPcdh regulation and highlight important functions of C2H2-ZFPs in enhancer-promoter interactions.
abstract_zh: 锌指蛋白（ZFP或ZNF）构成哺乳动物中最大的转录因子家族；然而，其调控机制在很大程度上仍不明确。在此，我们提出COP（C2H2-ZFP占据预测器），一种基于深度学习的启发式筛选工具，将DNA序列与蛋白质一级和二级特征相结合，以评估ZFP的基因组富集情况。将COP应用于小鼠成簇原钙粘蛋白（cPcdh）基因位点，我们识别出数十种可能参与CTCF介导基因调控的C2H2-ZFP，其中Wiz（广泛散布的锌指蛋白）拥有最多的12个锌指结构。通过在内源性Wiz基因上添加Myc标签，我们确认了Wiz在三个Pcdh簇中所有CTCF结合位点（CBS）元件上的富集。遗传实验显示，在体外神经元细胞和体内小鼠大脑中，Wiz缺失导致cPcdh基因表达水平显著升高。最后，整合的ChIP-seq、RNA-seq和4C-seq分析表明，Wiz以基因组距离偏倚的方式调控CTCF/cohesin占据及长程增强子-启动子接触。综合这些发现，揭示了Wiz在将cohesin占据与长程cPcdh调控耦合中的关键作用，并强调了C2H2-ZFP在增强子-启动子相互作用中的重要功能。
